# Did this API version break existing clients?

> Paste two OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 JSON documents and see exactly which changes would break an existing client — a removed endpoint, a parameter that became required, a narrowed type, a removed enum value. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
